parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Outline one way that Freeman (2008) used virtual reality to assess the symptoms of
schizophrenia.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the study by Sensky (2000) that used cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT) as a
treatment for schizophrenia.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two strengths of the study by Sensky.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate explanations of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), including a discussion of
reductionism versus holism. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the overload theory of personal space, using shoppers as an example.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the study by Robson et al. (2011) about table spacing in restaurants.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Robson et al.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about advertising applications (brand
recognition in children, advertising and consumer personality, effective slogans).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about advertising applications (brand
recognition in children, advertising and consumer personality, effective slogans), including a
discussion on the use of children in psychological research. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘chronic’ pain.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
There are medical and psychological techniques for managing and controlling pain. There
are also alternative techniques to these.
Outline two alternative techniques for managing and controlling pain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between a medical technique and an alternative
technique for managing and controlling pain.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about practitioner and patient interpersonal
skills (non-verbal communications and verbal communications).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about practitioner and patient interpersonal
skills (non-verbal communications and verbal communications), including a discussion of
generalisability. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two team roles as proposed by Belbin (1981).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the theory of group development (Tuckman, 1965).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the theory of group development.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about health and safety in organisational work
conditions (accidents at work, reducing accidents at work, safety promotion campaigns).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about health and safety in organisational work
conditions (accidents at work, reducing accidents at work, safety promotion campaigns),
including a discussion about experiments.
